description.zh: 喜歡研究程式設計、Web 開發與 Minecraft、Discord、node.js 相關技術。
description.en: I enjoy programming, web development and technologies related to Minecraft, Discord, and Node.js.

zh: 我是一名喜歡研究程式設計與網路技術的學生。平時會製作網站、Discord 相關工具與各種自己感興趣的專案。
我平常在 Windows 11 上寫程式，並透過 Git push 將成果部署到虛擬機。
目前我擁有三台虛擬機：一台是 Oracle VM 4C24GB 永久免費方案（新加坡機房、ARM64、Ubuntu 22.04），用來架設 Nginx 網頁伺服器（搭配 Cloudflare）、Discord 機器人（discord.py）、搜尋引擎、Wiki.js 與 Artalk 留言系統；
一台是 Oracle VM E2 micro 永久免費方案（新加坡機房、x86、Ubuntu 22.04），用來測試 BedrockBridge 外掛；
另一台是 OVHCloud VM（AMD Ryzen 7 7700 8-Core、16GB RAM、香港機房、Ubuntu 22.04），用來運行一個約 850 人的公開社群專案。
en: I’m a student who loves exploring programming and web technologies. I build websites, Discord-related tools, and various projects that I’m personally interested in.
I usually write code on Windows 11 and deploy it to my virtual machines via Git push.

I currently run three VMs: an Oracle VM 4C24GB Always Free instance (Singapore, ARM64, Ubuntu 22.04) that hosts an Nginx web server with Cloudflare, a Discord bot using discord.py, a search engine, Wiki.js, and the Artalk comment system;
an Oracle VM E2 micro Always Free instance (Singapore, x86, Ubuntu 22.04) used for testing BedrockBridge plugins;
and an OVHCloud VM (AMD Ryzen 7 7700 8-Core, 16GB RAM, Hong Kong, Ubuntu 22.04) that runs a public community project with around 850 members.
This experience has helped me become more familiar with Linux and server operations.
I can handle basic Ubuntu/Linux CLI commands, know a little Python, and work with JavaScript, CSS, HTML, and PHP. My main interest is frontend development.

description2.zh: 我喜歡從實際的問題出發，慢慢研究技術並將它實作出來。
description2.en: I like starting from real-world problems, learning how things work and turning ideas into working projects.
